2	// Package saga contains orchestrators that implement long–running, transactional
3	// workflows using the Saga pattern.  Each saga coordinates several local
4	// transactions across multiple micro-services and provides compensating actions
5	// for failures.

7	// VIPPurchaseSaga coordinates every action needed when a user buys a VIP pass
8	// for an event: debiting the customer’s wallet, locking and confirming the
9	// ticket, unlocking exclusive content, emitting audit trails, and publishing a
10	// “VIP Purchased” domain event.
11	//
12	// The orchestrator is deliberately placed in the orchestrator service rather
13	// than the ticketing or wallet services because it stitches together concerns
14	// across bounded contexts (wallet, ticketing, content, compliance).

25	)

32	// whenever a user presses the shiny “BUY VIP” button.

34		UserID        string          // Unique identifier for the user
35		EventID       string          // Unique identifier for the event / show
36		Amount        decimal.Decimal // Price of the VIP pass
37		Currency      string          // ISO-4217 currency code (e.g. “USD”)
38		CorrelationID string          // Trace / correlation id propagated across calls
39		Deadline      time.Duration   // Optional soft deadline for the saga
40	}

43	//
44	// A new instance should be created for every execution in order to keep the
45	// in-memory state (walletTxID, lockID, ...) isolated.  Persistent sagas can
46	// be implemented on top (e.g. outbox pattern or a saga repository), but are
47	// outside the scope of this file.
48	type VIPPurchaseSaga struct {
49		wallet   WalletService
50		ticket   TicketingService
51		content  ContentService
52		audit    AuditService
53		bus      EventBus
54		logger   *logrus.Entry
55		clockNow func() time.Time // test seam
56	}

58	// NewVIPPurchaseSaga wires all dependencies and returns a ready-to-run saga.
59	func NewVIPPurchaseSaga(
60		wallet WalletService,
61		ticket TicketingService,
62		content ContentService,
63		audit AuditService,
64		bus EventBus,
65		log *logrus.Logger,
66	) *VIPPurchaseSaga {
67		return &VIPPurchaseSaga{
68			wallet:   wallet,
69			ticket:   ticket,
70			content:  content,
71			audit:    audit,
72			bus:      bus,
73			logger:   log.WithField("saga", "VIPPurchase"),
74			clockNow: time.Now,
75		}
76	}

78	// Start executes the saga synchronously.  It blocks until either every step
79	// completes or a step fails and all compensations have been attempted.
80	//
81	// The function returns nil when the saga succeeds.  On failure it returns the
82	// *first* error that triggered a rollback; compensation errors are logged but
83	// do not override the original failure.
84	func (s *VIPPurchaseSaga) Start(ctx context.Context, cmd VIPPurchaseCommand) error {
85		ctx, cancel := s.withDeadline(ctx, cmd.Deadline)
86		defer cancel()
87	
88		log := s.logger.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
89			"correlation_id": cmd.CorrelationID,
90			"user_id":        cmd.UserID,
91			"event_id":       cmd.EventID,
92		})
93		log.Info("starting VIP purchase saga")
94	
95		var (
96			walletTxID string
97			lockID     string
98			passID     string
99		)
100	
101		// Steps with their compensations in forward order.
102		steps := []sagaStep{
103			{
104				name: "debit-wallet",
105				action: func(ctx context.Context) error {
106					txID, err := s.wallet.Debit(ctx, cmd.UserID, cmd.Amount, cmd.Currency, metadataFor(cmd))
107					walletTxID = txID
108					return err
109				},
110				compensate: func(ctx context.Context) error {
111					if walletTxID == "" {
112						return nil // nothing to compensate
113					}
114					return s.wallet.Credit(ctx, cmd.UserID, cmd.Amount, cmd.Currency, metadataFor(cmd))
115				},
116			},
117			{
118				name: "lock-vip-pass",
119				action: func(ctx context.Context) error {
120					id, err := s.ticket.LockVIPPass(ctx, cmd.UserID, cmd.EventID)
121					lockID = id
122					return err
123				},
124				compensate: func(ctx context.Context) error {
125					if lockID == "" {
126						return nil
127					}
128					return s.ticket.ReleaseVIPPass(ctx, lockID)
129				},
130			},
131			{
132				name: "confirm-vip-pass",
133				action: func(ctx context.Context) error {
134					id, err := s.ticket.ConfirmVIPPass(ctx, lockID)
135					passID = id
136					return err
137				},
138				// After confirmation, releasing the pass is no longer an option, so
139				// compensation means issuing a refund & pass cancellation.
140				compensate: func(ctx context.Context) error {
141					if passID == "" {
142						return nil
143					}
144					errPass := s.ticket.CancelVIPPass(ctx, passID)
145					errRefund := s.wallet.Credit(ctx, cmd.UserID, cmd.Amount, cmd.Currency, metadataFor(cmd))
146					return errors.Join(errPass, errRefund)
147				},
148			},
149			{
150				name: "unlock-content",
151				action: func(ctx context.Context) error {
152					return s.content.UnlockVIPContent(ctx, cmd.UserID, cmd.EventID)
153				},
154				compensate: func(ctx context.Context) error {
155					return s.content.LockVIPContent(ctx, cmd.UserID, cmd.EventID)
156				},
157			},
158			{
159				// Audit must never fail the transaction.  We log but swallow errors
160				// so that the user experience is unaffected by compliance concerns.
161				name: "audit-trail",
162				action: func(ctx context.Context) error {
163					payload := map[string]any{
164						"user_id":   cmd.UserID,
165						"event_id":  cmd.EventID,
166						"amount":    cmd.Amount.String(),
167						"currency":  cmd.Currency,
168						"wallet_tx": walletTxID,
169						"pass_id":   passID,
170					}
171					if err := s.audit.Record(ctx, "vip_purchase", payload); err != nil {
172						log.WithError(err).Warn("audit trail failed")
173					}
174					return nil
175				},
176			},
177			{
178				name: "publish-domain-event",
179				action: func(ctx context.Context) error {
180					event := VIPPassPurchased{
181						UserID:   cmd.UserID,
182						EventID:  cmd.EventID,
183						PassID:   passID,
184						Amount:   cmd.Amount,
185						Currency: cmd.Currency,
186						Time:     s.clockNow(),
187					}
188					return s.bus.Publish(ctx, event)
189				},
190			},
191		}
192	
193		// Execute each step and handle rollback on error.
194		var completed []sagaStep
195		for _, st := range steps {
196			log := log.WithField("step", st.name)
197			if err := st.action(ctx); err != nil {
198				log.WithError(err).Error("step failed, triggering compensation")
199				s.rollback(ctx, completed, log)
200				return fmt.Errorf("vip purchase saga failed on step %q: %w", st.name, err)
201			}
202			log.Info("step succeeded")
203			completed = append(completed, st)
204		}
205	
206		log.Info("VIP purchase saga completed successfully")
207		return nil
208	}

214	// sagaStep wraps a local transaction and its compensating action.
215	type sagaStep struct {
216		name       string
217		action     func(ctx context.Context) error
218		compensate func(ctx context.Context) error // optional
219	}

221	// rollback executes compensations in reverse order; errors are logged but
222	// ignored in the sense that they do not propagate to the caller.
223	//
224	// If any compensation itself panics, we recover and log, preventing a cascade.
225	func (s *VIPPurchaseSaga) rollback(ctx context.Context, completed []sagaStep, log *logrus.Entry) {
226		for i := len(completed) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
227			step := completed[i]
228			if step.compensate == nil {
229				continue
230			}
231			func() {
232				defer func() { // ensure we never panic during rollback
233					if r := recover(); r != nil {
234						log.WithField("step", step.name).
235							WithField("panic", r).
236							Error("panic during compensation")
237					}
238				}()
239				if err := step.compensate(ctx); err != nil {
240					log.WithField("step", step.name).
241						WithError(err).
242						Error("compensation failed")
243				} else {
244					log.WithField("step", step.name).
245						Info("compensation succeeded")
246				}
247			}()
248		}
249	}

254			return context.WithCancel(parent)
255		}

243		if current.LessThan(amount.Amount) {

302	func (b *memoryBus) Publish(ctx context.Context, aggID uuid.UUID, correlationID uuid.UUID, seq uint64, ev Event) error {
303		b.mu.RLock()
304		defer b.mu.RUnlock()

306		if b.closed {
307			return ErrClosedBus
308		}

310		env := Envelope{
311			AggregateID:   aggID,
312			CorrelationID: correlationID,
313			Sequence:      seq,

329				// For local dev/tests dropping is acceptable.

384	func safeCall(ctx context.Context, h Handler, env Envelope) {
385		defer func() {

387				// Log and swallow.  A real implementation would plug into zap/sentry.
388				_ = fmt.Errorf("%w: %v (handler=%v)", ErrHandlerPanic, r, reflect.ValueOf(h).Pointer())

398			b.mu.Unlock()

400		}
401		b.closed = true
402		// Copy subscribers so we can release lock before waiting.
403		subs := make([]*subscriber, 0, len(b.subscribers))
404		for s := range b.subscribers {

409		// Cancel contexts to stop goroutines.
410		for _, s := range subs {
411			s.cancel()
412			close(s.ch)
413		}

415		b.wg.Wait()
416		return nil
417	}
